about: Breakfast with Santa is a ticketed holiday morning at Dave & Buster's in Westminster.
It takes place Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM.
The address is 10667 Westminster Blvd Unit 100, Westminster, CO 80020.
Guests get early access before the store opens to the public.
The ticket includes a breakfast banquet and unlimited non-alcoholic drinks.
Kids can decorate holiday crafts and write letters to Santa.
Every guest gets a personal photo with Santa.
Santa's Ultimate Workshop tickets add a $10 Power Card with 3 hours of unlimited gameplay.
Tickets start at $27.94 and are sold only on Fever, not at the door.
Anyone age 2 and older needs a ticket.
Guests under 18 must come with an adult age 21 or older.
Seating may be at shared tables, so order together to sit together.
